ios.rules.title: Community rules
ios.rules.lead: Meridian has zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users. By commenting you agree not to post:
ios.rules.hate: hate speech, slurs or attacks on people for who they are
ios.rules.harassment: harassment, threats, or encouragement of violence or self-harm
ios.rules.illegal: illegal content, or personal information about anyone
ios.rules.impersonation: impersonation of other people or organisations
ios.rules.moderation: Reports are reviewed within 24 hours. Comments that break the rules are removed and their authors are banned from commenting. You can report any comment and block any commenter.
ios.lang.unavailable: Translation is unavailable right now. Try again later.
